name: Object-Centric Representation

legacy_aliases: Decomposes Phase 2A proposed R1 object-centric relational candidate into R3 object base + R4 relation extension
object_model: Background color fixed to 0; foreground objects are same-color 4-connected components. IDs sorted by (top,left,color,mask lexicographic). Store color, occupied-cell mask, bbox, h/w, area, rational centroid, shape signature, border/contact flags. Eight-connectivity and alternate background are separate future variants.
relation_model: No relation edges used by the R3 selector grammar; position, color, shape, size, and border are object-local selectors only.
composition_model: One selected object action per candidate; composition and conditional relation rules disabled.
parameterization_semantics: Object selectors are one of: exact color; area rank among current objects; exact normalized bbox aspect/shape signature; border-contact boolean. Invalid collision/out-of-grid candidates are rejected; all params are fit/verified using training demos only.
search_interface: Parser emits representation records; candidate is one selector+action+parameter hypothesis; deterministic grammar order, cap10; exact demonstration fit; no test access.
